name: bosch-copilot
description: AI coding assistant for VS Code powered by Bosch hosted Claude (Anthropic) and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Inline completions, chat, agentic mode, and full MCP support.

chatParticipants.name: bosch-copilot
chatParticipants.description: Local-first AI coding assistant powered by Qwen / Ollama.

commands.name: fix
commands.description: Find and fix bugs in the selected / active code

commands.name: test
commands.description: Generate unit tests for the selected / active code

commands.name: refactor
commands.description: Refactor the selected / active code for clarity

enumDescriptions: Azure OpenAI API — GPT, o-series, embeddings (Bosch BMF endpoint #1). Requires api-version.
Vertex AI Anthropic — Claude models via rawPredict (Bosch BMF endpoint #2).
Vertex AI OpenAI-compatible — Google, DeepSeek, Meta, z.AI models (Bosch BMF endpoints #3/#4).
Generic OpenAI-compatible — Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, or any custom endpoint.
bosch-copilot.apiType.description: API format for the configured endpoint. Must match the model provider.

bosch-copilot.endpoint.description: Base URL for the LLM platform (without model/deployment path). The plugin constructs the full URL automatically based on apiType and model. Bosch BMF: https://aoai-farm.bosch-temp.com/api. Local Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1.

bosch-copilot.apiKey.description: API key / subscription key value. Leave empty for local Ollama/LM Studio.

bosch-copilot.apiKeyHeader.description: HTTP header used to send the API key. 'Authorization' sends it as 'Bearer <key>' (standard for Bosch BMF).

bosch-copilot.apiVersion.description: api-version query parameter for Azure OpenAI requests. Only used when apiType is 'azure-openai'. Leave empty for other types.

bosch-copilot.chatModel.description: Deployment name for chat and agentic tasks. See the BMF Model Endpoint Reference for available deployment names. Developer tier ⭐: askbosch-prod-farm-openai-gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 or gpt-5-nano-2025-08-07.

bosch-copilot.completionModel.description: Deployment name for inline (ghost-text) completions. Use a fast, small model for low latency.

bosch-copilot.maxContextTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens of context (prompt + completion) the model can handle.

bosch-copilot.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for chat responses. Lower = more deterministic.

bosch-copilot.enableInlineCompletions.description: Enable inline ghost-text completions (press Tab to accept, Alt+] / Alt+[ to cycle suggestions).

bosch-copilot.enableTelemetry.description: Bosch-CoPilot ships with telemetry OFF. Toggle on only if you want to help improve the extension.

bosch-copilot.logLevel.description: Verbosity for the Bosch-CoPilot output channel.

enumDescriptions: Auto-detect: use fill-in-the-middle for *-base / *-coder models, instruct prompting otherwise.
Force fill-in-the-middle (FIM). Requires a model trained with FIM tokens, e.g. qwen2.5-coder:*-base.
Force instruct prompting via /chat/completions. Works with any chat model (qwen3.5, qwen3.6, llama3.1, ...).
bosch-copilot.completionStrategy.description: How inline completions are prompted. 'auto' is recommended.

bosch-copilot.completionDebounceMs.description: Idle time (ms) to wait after the last keystroke before requesting a completion. Lower = snappier but more requests.

bosch-copilot.completionMaxTokens.description: Maximum tokens generated per inline completion.

bosch-copilot.completionTemperature.description: Sampling temperature for inline completions. Low values keep completions deterministic.

bosch-copilot.completionPrefixLines.description: How many lines *before* the cursor to include as context.

bosch-copilot.completionSuffixLines.description: How many lines *after* the cursor to include as context.

bosch-copilot.completionMaxContextChars.description: Hard cap on prefix+suffix characters sent to the model. Text closest to the cursor is kept.

bosch-copilot.completionMultiline.description: Allow multi-line completions. When off, completions are truncated at the first newline.

bosch-copilot.completionCount.description: Number of alternative suggestions to request (cycle with Alt+] / Alt+[). >1 issues parallel requests and is slower.

bosch-copilot.prewarmOnActivation.description: Fire a tiny throw-away completion shortly after activation to pre-load the model. Eliminates cold-start latency on your first real ghost-text request.

bosch-copilot.agent.enabled.description: Route chat requests through the agent loop (ReAct + tool calling). Turn off to use plain streaming chat with no tools.

bosch-copilot.agent.maxIterations.description: Safety cap on how many model→tool→model cycles a single chat turn may run. When reached, the agent makes one final no-tools call so you always get an answer. Higher = handles deeper multi-file tasks at the cost of latency.

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_read_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the contents of a workspace-relative file and return the full UTF-8 text. Path must be relative to the workspace root.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a file from your workspace.

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_list_directory
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the immediate children of a workspace directory. Use "." for the workspace root.
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the contents of a directory.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory path; use "." for the workspace root.

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_grep_workspace
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search file CONTENTS for text (textSearch). Literal substring by default; set isRegex:true for a regex. Returns path:line:text rows. Use find_files to search file names instead.

query.description: Text to search for. Literal substring unless isRegex is true.

isRegex.description: Treat query as a JavaScript regular expression (default false).

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_find_files
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find files by GLOB against their path/name (fileSearch — searches names, not contents). E.g. "**/*.ts". Use grep_workspace to search file contents.

glob.description: Glob matched against file paths, e.g. "src/**/*.ts".

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_read_file_range
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a specific 1-based inclusive line range of a file, with line-number gutters. Prefer over read_file when you only need part of a large file.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a line range of a file.

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_find_symbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find where a symbol (class/function/method/interface/variable) is DEFINED in the workspace, by name, via the language server. Best first step for 'where is X defined'.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find a symbol's definition by name.

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_document_outline
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List the classes/methods/functions/fields of one file as an indented outline with line ranges, via the language server. Understand a file's shape before reading it fully.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Outline the symbols in a file.

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_find_references
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find ALL USAGES (references) of a symbol across the workspace via the language server. Provide the file path where it appears and the symbol name (optional line). Use to trace code flow.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find all usages of a symbol.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path containing an occurrence of the symbol.

line.description: Optional 1-based line where the symbol appears, to disambiguate.

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_go_to_definition
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Resolve where a symbol is DEFINED, starting from a usage of it, via the language server. Inverse of find_references.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path containing a usage of the symbol.

symbol.description: The exact symbol name to resolve.

line.description: Optional 1-based line where the symbol is used, to disambiguate.

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_write_file
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Write text content to a workspace-relative file. Overwrites by default; set createOnly:true to fail if the file already exists. Asks the user to confirm.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Write a file in your workspace (with confirmation).

createOnly.description: If true, fail when the file already exists.

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_apply_diff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Replace a unique exact substring in a workspace file. oldText must match exactly once. Asks the user to confirm.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Apply a targeted patch to a file (with confirmation).

oldText.description: Exact substring to replace (must match once).

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_run_terminal_command
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run a shell command in the workspace and return stdout, stderr, and exit code. Asks the user to confirm.

languageModelTools.name: bosch_copilot_ask_followup_question
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Ask the user a clarifying question when the request is ambiguous or you are missing information the other tools cannot provide. Provide options for multiple-choice, or omit for free text. Returns the user's answer.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Let the assistant ask you a clarifying question.

question.description: The clarifying question to ask the user.

options.description: Optional suggested answers shown as selectable choices.
